title: Fire Doors
activity: Fire door leaf, frame, gaps, seals, ironmongery and signage
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Certification label on top of the leaf present and undamaged?
Gaps 3 mm max and even – head, jambs, meeting stiles and threshold (or threshold smoke seal fitted)? Over 3 mm: check the data sheet.

guide.title: Fire door gaps – pass line (tightest)
rows: 3 mm max, even (£1 coin fits snug)
3 mm max – or a threshold/drop-down smoke seal fitted
Not an automatic fail – check the door's data sheet (typical limits 2–4 mm sides; 8–10 mm threshold on fire-only doors)
guide.note: Ask the fitter: 'What's the max gap and the threshold gap for this door, and what seals does it take?' If they can't answer, flag it – they're fitting without the data sheet.
guide.src: BS 8214:2016 (9.5.3); BWF Fire Door Alliance; Atlantic ITP 10.2; Errigal riser door checklist
